areas.evidence: Retains the observed 10 rows of three 16-byte records and their existing field accesses. Local views describe the observed u16 at state+0x14A and palette-shadow base 0x03001F40+0x1FA; the historical save-style alias does not establish persistence. The BG object remains two u16 fields. Mode 0 detail and mode 1 record pointers retain the existing valid selected-row/column preconditions and helper addresses, with no extra object or memory access. The unescaped u8 page offset keeps its sole sub_0800CE30()?10:0 producer and two table-index uses, giving the same values for every full helper return. This checkpoint adds one initialized u32 selected-row sum bound to original R0, immediately consumed by the existing record source-address calculation. Its real operands, full unsigned arithmetic and record copy remain unchanged. No dummy consumer, uninitialized register input, authored opcode, padding, qualifier, helper or callee ABI change is introduced. The emitted frame, accesses and all other source bodies are unchanged.

areas.label: Validate bounded initialization and menu paths
areas.evidence: Fresh private normal-base linked fixtures compare original EU, public 14 and selected 12. All 160 initialization-prefix cases pass with 480 actual entries and 480 explicitly enumerated pair comparisons; all 960 full-return cases pass with 2880 entries and 2880 explicit pair comparisons. The two scopes are separate and are not summed as unique coverage. Prefix spans stages 0..9, mode 0/1, four completion patterns and 00/A5 stack. Full paths span stages 0/9, modes 0/1, two completion patterns, five input schedules, visible counts 1/3/10, RNG 0/2 and final waits 0/2. Meaningful helper arguments, descriptor/record payloads, nonstack RAM, yields and full-return SP/R4-R11 agree. Selected normal-active C is byte-for-byte the same complete object as the tested candidate and applied NM module. Helpers/scheduler are synthetic; arbitrary state, zero-visible underflow and general FSM equivalence remain unproved. Earlier mode-1 col+1 source-negative results remain historical and were not newly rerun for this checkpoint.

areas.label: Recover remaining register and control-flow layout
areas.evidence: The last 12 halfwords (+0xBC..+0xD4) came from the page offset zero. In the ROM the zero store is str r4,[sp,#668]: reload inherits the R4 reload register of the spilled selection across sub_0800CE30, so the source operand must still be the selection pseudo at reload time. CSE always folds a known-zero register source to const 0 (cost 0 < pseudo cost 1), so the zero is a copy of sel hidden by asm("" : "=r"(zero) : "0"(sel)) and assigned before the conditional 10 (off10 now u32, if-form, not ternary: the ternary stores 10 first). sel keeps its REG_EQUAL first set, so its doubled live length still keeps it spilled. off10 then lost its own doubled live length (first set no longer constant) and took SL from the hoisted gUnk_084F0B10 pointer; a trailing asm("" : : "g"(off10)) extends its life (no code: the spilled operand satisfies g) and restores the original allocation.
